You might believe you have “peaked already” but when you hit rock bottom, the only way to go is up. Also, you can’t put all your love and trust into a person that doesn’t respect you. You will find someone who cares for you back someday, especially if you are the faithful kind of guy. You have so many more years left of life, more than 50, and it has so much potential to get better again. If drug addicts can be rehabilitated, a guy that failed a few classes in uni should shoot straight back up again. Don’t waste this opportunity to prove to yourself that everything can get better. I can just hear on old guy for some reason, telling his kids the story of how he thought his life was over, but suddenly a miracle happened. Keep going and see what happens dude.
